summary: Create a GitHub PAT and install/configure the GitHub data source in Grafana Cloud.

needs.description: A GitHub personal access token with repo read scope, created on github.com by the learner during the path (guide steps on github.com); the test needs a valid PAT to pass Save & test.
needs.evidence: create-github-token milestone; Before you begin: GitHub account with access to repositories

needs.description: grafana-github-datasource plugin installable (or pre-installed) on the stack; plugin catalog install permitted.
Grafana org Admin role to install/add data sources.

reviewNotes: Steps leave the GitHub datasource created; a pre-existing github datasource may collide with the step that adds it. PAT secret must be supplied to the test.
